created_prompt: Please create a specific, actionable three-year plan to take a content maker from current state (posting cooking videos to 1.2M followers) to having an online platform and a published cookbook. She currently specializes in quick, healthy recipes. She is unsure whether to do do traditional or self-publishing for the cookbook. Her time and budget is limited and she only has 3 days off each week. Include clear milestones and a timeline.
